title: The AI Soul Passport
claim: An AI identity can remain independently verifiable across device migration, an offline fork, deterministic reattachment, and a copied-appearance counterfeit because continuity is derived from canonical content-addressed frames rather than location or resemblance.
invariants: Every admitted AI turn is an immutable recursive-canonical-JSON frame addressed with browser Web Crypto SHA-256.
Displayed identity state and deterministic non-humanoid morphology derive only from a verified frame.
Every frame independently recomputes its content address, morphology seed, state-read addresses, schema, device, sequence, and previous link before admission.
Older verified selves remain immutable and browsable without replacing the current verified head.
An offline append remains a separate dimension until an ordered candidate ladder finds the first empty contradiction set.
A graft records exact source frame, selected base, candidate order, contradiction sets, target head, and imported identity fields.
A counterfeit that copies appearance but changes identity content is rejected and cannot mutate the last verified self.
positive_path: Append a synthetic AI turn on Lumen Tablet.
Migrate the verified identity to Archive Cube and append another AI turn.
Migrate the same verified identity to Field Lens.
Advance Archive Cube online while Field Lens appends offline from their shared verified base.
Compare the offline frame's declared read addresses against the newest-to-oldest candidate ladder.
Select the first contradiction-free base and append a graft frame with exact provenance.
failure_path: Clone the verified head's hologram appearance, change one synthetic memory and one declared read address while retaining copied address and morphology metadata, then independently recompute canonical hashes and reject the counterfeit while preserving the prior verified head.
